title: SRE & Platform
subtitle: Keep systems - from web services to GPU clusters - fast, safe and running
summary: Run production systems reliably at scale, from the Linux kernel to multi-region platforms and GPU clusters.
expert: Diagnoses failures from the kernel to the GPU fabric, runs reliability through SLOs and error budgets rather than heroics, designs platforms that survive real traffic and real outages, and leads incidents calmly - at the level of an SRE at a top technology company.

benchmarks.title: Certifications
benchmarks.detail: RHCSA or LFCS by the end of Foundation; CKA and Terraform Associate by the end of Intermediate; CKS and a cloud associate certification by the end of Advanced.

benchmarks.title: University labs
benchmarks.detail: A container runtime built from namespaces and cgroups; the MIT 6.5840 Raft lab test suite passed.

benchmarks.title: Operated, not just built
benchmarks.detail: Your platform runs 30+ days with an SLO dashboard, burn-rate alerts, an on-call log and at least two written postmortems.

benchmarks.title: GPU clusters
benchmarks.detail: nccl-tests across nodes reach the expected bus bandwidth, and you diagnose five injected faults (driver, NVLink, InfiniBand, Slurm, storage).

benchmarks.title: Defended out loud
benchmarks.detail: Pass a 45-minute NALSD design interview, then defend your capstone platform for 30 minutes.
